Gamble Plantation Historic State Park.alt: Front of the white Gamble Mansion, a two-story house with six tall round columns, double verandas and a low pediment, with a straight path leading to the front doors across the lawn
Gamble Plantation Historic State Park.caption: The front of the Gamble Mansion at Gamble Plantation Historic State Park in Ellenton, photographed in 2010.

Gamble Plantation Historic State Park.verification: Commons file 'Gamble Plantation SP mansion01' by Ebyabe, CC BY-SA 3.0, taken 2010-10-22, geotag 27.5225,-82.526667 at the park on U.S. 301 in Ellenton; description links Gamble Plantation Historic State Park. Visually: the distinctive white Doric-columned two-story antebellum mansion with double verandas, benches on the tabby porch and the low cistern structure at right, the same building as the 2020 Paul R. Burley Commons series. Different frame from the guide hero (close angled veranda view). No people. Live Commons licence checked: CC BY-SA 3.0.
